comment: Curated inputs for the combo answer-quality A/B (DEC-162). Every scenario carries an inline `request` referencing real Commander Spellbook oracle ids and variants (sourced from a real bulk-export fetch, 2026-08-22) rather than the slice E eval fixtures' synthetic oracle ids, which exist in no real corpus and would make both A/B legs produce byte-identical prompts. Card `oracleText` here is illustrative, not verified against Scryfall (no live Scryfall call was made to build this file) -- review it against the real card text before spending money on a live run.

scenarios.rationale: Automatic enrichment: every piece of a real two-card variant (5702-8097: Avatar of Growth + Springheart Nantuko) is present and the user did not ask about combos. Tests whether unrequested combo context helps or distracts.
